# .codex - Graphiti agent memory (generated by agent-memory)

This folder is generated by the `agent-memory` npm package. Hooks use the Graphiti MCP endpoint to store and retrieve memories.

## Files
- `config.js` — endpoint + group defaults.
- `hooks/` — Node-based hook scripts.
- `hooks/common/` — shared MCP client, user helper, tag builder.

## Running hooks
Use Node 18+:
- `node .codex/hooks/session_start.js`
- `node .codex/hooks/before_command.js --command "make test"`
- `node .codex/hooks/after_command.js --kind Standard --text "always run make lint" --tool pytest`
- `node .codex/hooks/per_prompt.js --role user --text "We must split memory into its own package"` (auto-classifies Direction/Decision/Requirement and dedupes by fingerprint; add `--force` to bypass)

Environment overrides:
- `GRAPHITI_MCP_URL` (default {{GRAPHITI_ENDPOINT}})
- `GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID` (default {{GRAPHITI_GROUP}})
- `CODING_USER_NAME` or `USER`

## Docker stack
`docker-compose.graphiti.yml` provisions Neo4j, Graph, and graphiti-mcp. Configure credentials in `.env.graphiti.example` (copy to `.env`).
